definitions.explanation: Small drop-shaped or bead-shaped pieces of chocolate formulated to hold their shape when baked. Used in cookies, muffins, scones, ice cream, pastries, and sweet breads. The standard Japanese term, matching the English product category.

examples.japanese: チョコチップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
チョコチップ{入|い}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クッキー→クッキー：10798_kukkii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: I baked cookies with chocolate chips in them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧チョコチップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}し{込|こ}む→流し込む：29655_nagashikomu⟧。
examples.english: Mix the chocolate chips into the batter and then pour it into the mold.

notes:
A shortened loanword from English 'chocolate chips' — the full form ⟦チョコレート→チョコレート：05183_chokoreeto⟧⟦チップ→チップ：11019_chippu⟧ also exists but is less common than the clipped チョコチップ, which pairs freely with any product name. Uses the same productive abbreviation pattern seen in チョコパン ('chocolate bread'), チョコ⟦アイス→アイス：06770_aisu⟧ ('chocolate ice cream'), and チョコ⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧ ('chocolate banana').

USAGE:
- Sold in supermarket baking sections alongside flour and sugar; usually in small resealable bags.
- Frequently appears in product names: チョコチップ⟦クッキー→クッキー：10798_kukkii⟧ ('chocolate chip cookies'), チョコチップ⟦メロンパン→メロンパン：28780_meronpan⟧ ('chocolate chip melon bread'), チョコチップ⟦アイス→アイス：06770_aisu⟧ ('chocolate chip ice cream').
- The flake-shaped variant is typically called チョコフレーク.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チョコチップクッキー: chocolate chip cookies
- チョコチップ⟦メロンパン→メロンパン：28780_meronpan⟧: chocolate chip melon bread
- チョコチップアイス: chocolate chip ice cream
- チョコチップ{入|い}り: containing chocolate chips
- チョコチップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: to add chocolate chips
- チョコチップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散|ち}らす→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧: to scatter chocolate chips (as topping)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦チョコレート→チョコレート：05183_chokoreeto⟧: chocolate — the base word; full, unabbreviated form.
- チョコ: chocolate — casual clipped form, used as a prefix in compounds and on its own in conversation.
- {板|いた}チョコ: bar chocolate; chocolate bar — the standard flat tablet form.
- チョコフレーク: chocolate flakes — thin flake-shaped chocolate pieces, often used as topping.
- ⟦チョコレート→チョコレート：05183_chokoreeto⟧⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧: chocolate sauce — liquid form used for topping.
